data.name: AIZASIA
data.detailed_description:
AIZASIA is an attractive platformer game containing adventures, actions and puzzles that offers a captivating and immersive experience through different challenges, obstacles and interesting interaction events.

Game progression:

• Solving the puzzles.

• Avoiding the obstacles.

• Collecting all the 3 stars including the lifesavers, coins, and hearts.

• Releasing tension by crashing the crates and enemies beside that collecting the rewards in the game.

• Destroy the enemies.

• Find and collect the hidden objects.

Objectives:

• Find and collect all the 3 Stars in each level by solving all the simple puzzles which are mostly very clear and closed to each other. every puzzle will activate another one until the 3 STARS will be collected to be able to activate the gate at the end of the level which will allow you to pass into the next level.

• Pass the obstacles safely to complete the game to the end. Once the player falls down outside the platforms, you will lose one life and at the same time you will restart from the last point you started the game or from the last checkpoint if you activate it. Some obstacles need you to be more patient and hard headed, and some of them need you to think of the best way to save lives (Retries), while some are easy but clever.

• Defeating the enemies. You have different ways to kill any enemy in the game, either by using the spin button and/or clicking on the combination buttons, for Sony controller (X then O), for Xbox controller (A then B) and if you are using the Keyboard press (Space then E), the other way that you can do jumping over the enemy to decrease it's health until you get chance to kill it. 

• Search for the (Diamond & Gem), there are hidden objects in some levels, if you are able to find them, then you may get a chance to add more lives- retries, health and coins to the player's inventory. These items are such an extra bonus for the player in the game, but not mandatory. Beside these items, there are some hidden objects that could be inside the enemies and/or the breakable boxes including the Power Up items are mostly invisible in some places in the levels, and of course we will not forget to mention the lucky boxes even it's a very few in the game, and more...

The game was made just for fun and to have a happy time alone and/or with friends, including challenging the ego of the player himself. It will be upgraded into better versions of the mechanics, environments and obstacles including the enemy behavior in the near future. And by the way,  there's a serious plan to release some bundles such as  (Time Challenge), (2.5d) and (Gravity) levels which will be added to the game as soon as possible.

Your positive feedback is appreciated.

data.short_description: Defeat enemies, solve the puzzles, find the hidden objects and finally collect the three stars to pass into the next level with lots of coins. Funny game, lovely interaction and smart obstacles. Realistic graphics and unique designs with different environments.
